about.heading: Who's building it
about.body: I'm Supakorn (Ohm), a Computer Engineering student at SIIT, Thammasat University, and a full-stack developer in Bangkok. I've built internal business tools, AI systems and modern web interfaces, including as an AI Developer intern at Mizuhada Group and a UX/UI Researcher intern at BAKA Group.
